close_reason: Cold-audited at origin/main a3a9761d1: refuted invariant. The three take_while construction targets still have different private return layouts, but every wrapper publishes one uniform ValueRef return_form; native per-member continuations decode each private layout into that public contract. This is intentional and documented, not a calling-convention violation; the exact-list-position dispatch executes correctly.
description:
From the fz-kdt.132 build (2026-09-02, at c31b309d0): the take_while
construction wrapper's members 0/1 publish shape{lane,lane} while
member 2 publishes a packed lane -- a genuine return-form disagreement
within one construction. Harmless today (the covering member takes
everything that matters and marshals its own form consistently) and
NOT what broke the fz-kdt.138 flip (that was the coverage defect
fz-kdt.132 fixed), but it is a real instance of the class fz-kdt.132's
ticket originally hypothesized: fz-kdt.97's law -- one recursion
component publishes one return contract -- extended to construction
members (every member of one CallableConstruction publishes the same
return form, derived from the construction's joined type/demand).
Direction: check contract_transport_layout's reach; the fz-kdt.96
per-member projection machinery is where member layouts diverge.
Latent until something routes values to members 0/1 specifically
(fz-kdt.138's exactness is the candidate trigger -- re-measure this
wrapper under the flip when 138 lands).
title: take_while's construction members disagree on return form: the fz-kdt.97 one-return-contract law extended to construction members
